description: Maine WIC provides food benefits, nutrition support and breastfeeding help. Parents and caregivers can apply for eligible infants and children in their care.
introduction: Maine WIC provides food benefits, nutrition support and breastfeeding help. Parents and caregivers can apply for eligible infants and children in their care.

who: Eligible groups include pregnant participants, lactating participants, recent postpartum participants and children younger than five living in Maine.
Income and nutrition-screening conditions apply. MaineCare, SNAP or TANF proof can establish an income-eligibility pathway.
sections.get: The clinic assigns foods for the participant and provides nutrition education and referrals. Use the current food list and clinic instructions rather than an older description of paper checks.
sections.docs: Prepare identification, physical-address proof and income or qualifying-benefit documentation. Ask the clinic which applicants must attend and what else is needed for the initial visit. Keep copies of uploaded records.
sections.apply:
1. Use Apply and Get Started to contact a nearby clinic or request a staff call through the contact form.
  2. Arrange an appointment and confirm the checklist.
  3. Complete the eligibility and health assessment and ask how food benefits are used.
sections.after: Keep follow-up appointments and tell the clinic about feeding concerns or difficulty buying an approved item. Ask about breastfeeding help and current shopping guidance. For state program questions, call 800-437-9300.

faqs: Can a father or foster parent apply for a child?
Yes. Maine lists fathers, legal guardians, adoptive parents and foster parents among caregivers who can apply.
Does MaineCare proof complete WIC enrollment?
No. It can establish income eligibility, but WIC still completes its category and nutrition review.
Can I request a call rather than find an office myself?
The state contact form allows a WIC staff member to call and arrange an appointment.
How long should I allow for the first visit?
Maine’s current application page suggests about an hour. Confirm the appointment arrangements with your clinic.
